name: KM3NeT
summary: Two-site Mediterranean neutrino infrastructure: ARCA targets higher energies and ORCA lower energies. Early configurations have produced published dark-matter searches, while the full infrastructure remains under phased construction.
detection_principle: Multi-PMT digital optical modules record Cherenkov light in water; directions and energy spectra test signals from the Sun and Galactic center.

status.label: Partly operating, with further construction continuing
status.evidence: The paper explicitly describes infrastructure under construction, with partial arrays already taking data and completing searches.

phases.name: ARCA
phases.description: Phased operation and construction of the high-energy array offshore Italy

phases.name: ORCA
phases.description: Phased operation and construction of the low-energy array offshore France

results.summary: ARCA Galactic-center and ORCA solar searches found no dark-matter signal, setting annihilation or scattering upper limits.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
